title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
overview: The Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate course is designed to equip participants with the skills needed to design and implement AI solutions on Microsoft Azure. This course prepares candidates for the AI-102 exam by covering key areas such as AI solution design, machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and AI integration.
audience: AI engineers and developers working with Azure.
Data scientists and machine learning practitioners.
IT professionals interested in AI and Azure technologies.
Individuals preparing for the Azure AI Engineer Associate certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of Azure AI services and solutions.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for implementing AI solutions using Azure services.
Case Studies: Real-world examples to illustrate the application of AI technologies.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore AI challenges and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Natural language processing and computer vision
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of AI technologies and services on Azure.
To develop practical skills in designing and implementing AI solutions using Azure.
To prepare participants for the Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate certification exam.
To familiarize participants with real-world AI applications and integration scenarios.
